title: Huko Suzuka, hata bango la makaribisho linazungumzia mbio
label: Bango la Suzuka

text.My father took me to Suzuka City in Mie: Baba yangu alinipeleka katika Jiji la Suzuka, Mkoa wa Mie.
text.My father drove the car from Nagoya to S: Baba aliendesha gari kutoka Nagoya hadi Suzuka Circuit.
text.When we got off the highway in Suzuka, a: Tulipotoka kwenye barabara kuu huko Suzuka, bango lililoandikwa ‘Welcome to SUZUKA’ lilitukaribisha ghafla.
text.And it had a racing checkered flag patte: Lilikuwa pia na mchoro wa bendera ya mbio yenye miraba.
Nilikuwa najiuliza kama lingekuwa hivyo, na kweli lilikuwa hivyo.
text.I felt like the whole town was saying \": Nilihisi kana kwamba mji mzima unasema ‘Karibu kwenye uwanja wa mbio,’ nami nikasisimka kidogo.
text.But even after getting off the highway,: Lakini hata baada ya kutoka barabara kuu, unaendesha kwa muda kwenye barabara za kawaida hadi Suzuka Circuit.
text.In the passenger seat, I started to worr: Nikiwa kwenye kiti cha abiria, nilianza kuhangaikia mambo ambayo sikuhitaji kuyawazia.
text.At F1 time, surely tens of thousands, ev: Wakati wa F1, bila shaka makumi ya maelfu, hata mamia ya maelfu ya watu kutoka Japani na nchi nyingine hukusanyika hapa kutazama.
text.\"Can all those people stay at hotels?\": ‘Je, watu wote hao watapata nafasi hotelini?’
text.\"Can everyone really get to the circuit: ‘Je, kila mtu ataweza kufika kwenye uwanja wa mbio?’
text.I got a little worried about the transpo: Nilihofia kidogo usafiri na eneo linalozunguka Suzuka Circuit, hadi nikaanza kuwa na wasiwasi peke yangu.
text.But F1 is held here properly every year,: Lakini F1 hufanyika hapa vizuri kila mwaka, kwa hiyo lazima mambo yako sawa.
text.On race days, shuttle buses and extra tr: Inasemekana siku za mbio mabasi ya usafiri na treni za ziada huondoka kwenye stesheni za karibu.
text.The people of Suzuka run this big event: Watu wa Suzuka huendesha tukio hili kubwa vizuri kila mwaka.
text.Also, because it takes time to get there: Na kwa kuwa safari ya kufika huko huchukua muda, unasisimka zaidi unapoiona hatimaye sehemu ya mbio.
text.The longer the road to the goal, the hap: Kadiri safari ya kuelekea lengo inavyokuwa ndefu, ndivyo furaha ya kulifikia inavyokuwa kubwa.
Ni kama mbio kabisa. Natania tu.
text.And thank you to my father, who drove me: Na asante kwa baba yangu aliyeniendesha hadi kufikia lengo hilo.
